newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Innovest shares down on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Innovest shares down on requotation.

text.p: The shares of timber and construction firm Innovest Bhd were trading five cents lower at 8.50 ringgit at 0140 GMT after being requoted.

Innovest had been suspended and the company on Tuesday announced it was involved in a 300 million ringgit property development project in Madagascar, an island nation off southern Africa in the Indian ocean.
The company has shed its loss-making fast food business and was starting in new businesses, its vice president and financial controller, Chow Kek Tong, told Reuters in an interview on Tuesday.
Brokers and analysts said the new projects had been factored in ahead of the suspension.
